Dolores Abernathy
Okay. I'm checking the total one last time. Please make sure you signal me if you hear him coming.

Dolores Abernathy
Okay. I am closing and locking the register drawer. I will keep my hands visible and steady. Thank you for taking the steam wand. I am ready to show him the drawer is closed.
